propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state that the close precheck requires a MERGED commit reachable from HEAD, when the implementation in _referencing_commit_exists scans all history reachable from current HEAD regardless of merge status.
The close precheck is conditional on file_impact being recorded and the completion-verification gate being enabled, but the documentation presents it as unconditional.
The precheck accepts any transitive descendant of the ticket (built via list_descendants across epics/stories/tasks/bugs buckets), not just the ticket itself, but this is not documented.
The rebar transition --ref command enables closing a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree, but is entirely absent from AGENTS.md and omitted from CONTRIBUTING.md.
The real ordering rule enforcing land-before-close is the Verified +1 policy stated earlier in the documents, not the precheck mechanism.
